verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents integration with multiple LLM providers through their native SDKs. Its YAML configuration is explicitly described as letting you easily switch between models while version-controlling agent settings. A community user confirms running crews across various models, but notes that many OSS Ollama models struggle with tool calling, so a swap is not always behavior-neutral. Missing for 10: a concrete documented example of swapping providers without code changes or a list of supported providers, and stronger independent hands-on corroboration that swaps preserve agent behavior.
